title: Convert a camt.053 bank statement to CSV/Excel with plain Python
summary:
Most European banks give you the account statement as a camt.053 XML file (ISO 20022). It replaces the old MT940 text format. Accountants want it in Excel. Here is how to turn it into a clean CSV with only the Python standard library, and the traps that make naive parsers miss transactions.
Document
 └ BkToCstmrStmt
    └ Stmt              (one per account and period)
       ├ Acct/Id/IBAN
       ├ Bal            (opening and closing balance)
       └ Ntry           (one booked entry)
